messages:
Priya: Heads-up  were shipping the re-engage nurture + webinar invite bundle next week. Need final audience gating, locale copy, and dynamic-block rules by EOD Fri.
Ben: Quick ask  can we show a benchmark CTA to users who've run >5 evals in last 30d? want to surface the new latency/cost benchmark report.
Zoe: Yes. Segment rules I'm proposing: `inactive_30d` (no opens 30d), `eval_active` (ran >=1 eval in 30d), `trial_heavy` (trial usage >=7 days active). Combine `eval_active` + `inactive_30d` for targeted re-engage.
Carlos: Deliverability note: keep send cadence low for `inactive_30d` to avoid spam traps. Recommend 1k/hr for that segment, 3-email cadence over 14 days.
deliverability-bot: SPF/DKIM check: PASS. IP warmup status: IP2 ready, max suggested throughput 2k/hr for first 48h.
Priya: Ok adjust rate limits per segment then. Also need language variants: en-US, en-UK, fr-FR, de-DE. Zoe can you provide localized preheaders?
Zoe: Working on copy. Provisional preheaders: en-US "Weve improved latency + cost for trials"; en-UK "New performance benchmarks for power users"; fr-FR "Nouveaux repres de latence et cout"; de-DE "Neue Benchmarks: Latenz & Kosten".
Ben: For dynamic blocks: show `benchmark_cta` if `eval_count` >=5; show `webinar_invite` if `last_active` <= 60 and region in (NA, EU); show `case_study` for enterprise_tier only.
Priya: Add fallback to generic hero for locales we don't have. Also ensure compact plain-text and images optimized <150KB.
Carlos: CRM routing: webhook to Salesforce for any click where `intent_score` >=0.85. Use event `newsletter_click_high_intent`. Make sure rate limit on webhook: 10 req/s.
Priya: UTM template: `utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=reengage_bundle&utm_segment={segment}&utm_variant={variant}`.
Zoe: Subject lines to test: A) "Weve updated our performance benchmarks" B) "Come to the benchmark webinar  see the numbers". Also a re-engage variant: C) "Missed you  see whats new at Redwood".
Ben: A/B plan: 15% holdout for `inactive_30d` as control; test subjects A vs C in split 50/50 across remaining. For `eval_active` test benchmark CTA placement (top vs bottom).
deliverability-bot: Seedlist results: inbox placement 92% for en-US HTML, open rate simulated 18%. Recommend swapping the hero image for mobile-first variant.
Priya: Good catch. Design  can you supply mobile-first hero + plain-text by Thu 10am? Also need a short alt-text summary under 120 chars.
Zoe: I'll also prepare translated alt-texts and simplified text-only modules for locales.
Carlos: QA checklist: validate localization, validate dynamic-block logic with 50-user preview, verify UTM mapping, check unsubscribe link, confirm webhook auth (HMAC header).
Ben: Preview link (internal): https://app.redwood.com/campaigns/reengage_bundle/preview/1854001234
Priya: After preview approval, we do a staged rollout: 10% of `eval_active` + 5% of `inactive_30d` day 1, ramp to 50% day 2, full day 4 depending on complaint rates <0.1% and CTR lifts.
Growth: I'll monitor metrics: deliverability, opens, CTR, clicks to benchmark report, webinar signups. Will post hourly updates during rollout.
Priya: Thanks all  I'll compile final send spec and publish to the campaign board tomorrow AM. Any blockers?
Ben: None from content side.
Zoe: Translation will be done by EOD Fri.
Carlos: Webhook auth test scheduled for 2pm tomorrow.
Priya: Great. Wrapping up  final spec will include audience queries, rate limits, A/B plan, webhooks, QA checklist, asset links.
